assets.name: enchanted-forest

request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone background for a personal salary and investment web app's Fantasy HD-2D theme.
Primary request: An enchanted emerald forest, luminous turquoise stream winding between mossy pixel-art rocks, ancient stone arches and ruined columns tucked near the sides, layered ferns and glowing tiny highlights. The middle opens into spacious mist and a calm river clearing.
Style/medium: original premium HD-2D JRPG landscape, finely detailed pixel-art terrain in layered diorama-like depth, painterly cinematic atmosphere, subtle tilt-shift, crisp tiny pixel highlights, high craft and inviting fantasy mood.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 landscape, preferably 2048x1152; full bleed continuous environment. Detailed edges and expansive quiet center that will sit behind dark navy interface panels. Do not draw those panels. Strong sense of depth and delicate atmosphere; no focal clutter in central 55 percent.
Color palette: deep emerald, moss, dark teal, luminous turquoise, gentle mint highlights.
Constraints: one complete scene, not a collage; no text, no logos, no watermark, no characters, no people, no UI, no borders.
